summary.text: Jana Hughes is a member of the Nebraska Legislature who has represented District 24 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Hughes was born in Friend, Nebraska, and earned a bachelor's degree from Texas A&M University in 1993.
Her career experience includes working as a substitute teacher and group exercise instructor.
Hughes assumed office in the Nebraska Legislature on January 4, 2023.
Ballotpedia lists her 2025-2026 committee assignments as Education, where she is vice chair, and Natural Resources.
She advanced from the May 12, 2026 primary.
